header.running_head: The Chapter About How the Sahabah (RA) Spent in the Path of Allaah

blocks.text: Chapter Eight — The Chapter About How the Sahabah (RA) Spent in the Path of Allaah

This chapter highlights how Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) spent their wealth and everything that Allaah granted them in the path of Allaah and in avenues where Allaah's pleasure is found. The chapter also highlights how they loved this more than spending on themselves and how they preferred others above themselves even though they suffered poverty
The Encouragement Rasulullaah ﷺ gave and the Fervour the Sahabah (RA) had for Spending in the Path of Allaah
The Encouragement that Rasulullaah ﷺ Gave to Spend in the path of Allaah
The Narration of Hadhrat Jareer (RA) in this Regard

Hadhrat Jareer reports that they were once with Rasulullaah ﷺ one morning when some people belonging to the Mudar tribe arrived. They were barefoot and practically naked. All they had were striped shawls or cloaks and their swords hanging from their necks. The expression on Rasulullaah ﷺ's face actually changed when he saw their poverty. He then went into his room and when he emerged, he gave instructions to Hadhrat Bilaal (RA), who duly called out the Adhaan and then the Iqaamah. After Rasulullaah ﷺ led the salaah, he addressed the people with the following verses of the Qur'aan:

blocks.arabic_text: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَكُمْ مِّنْ نَّفْسٍ وَّاحِدَةٍ وَّخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيْرًا وَّنِسَآءً ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ الَّذِيْ تَسَآءَلُوْنَ بِهٖ وَالْاَرْحَامَ ۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيْبًا
